objective: Test a sharp one-sided lower bound at half-rank nine, including possible extra variables, against arbitrary quadratic functions and arbitrary adaptive affine questions.
status: Proved: For every Boolean quadratic total Q of polar half-rank r and every single Boolean quadratic observation on only one evaluator, exactly 2^r terminal cases are necessary and sufficient under repeated separate affine hulls and arbitrary adaptive visible XOR questions.
title: Determine how much a single one-sided sketch can save at rank nine
